Functions.Original: static inline int   Extra_BitWordNum( int nBits )    { return nBits/(8*sizeof(unsigned)) + ((nBits%(8*sizeof(unsigned))) > 0);  }

Functions.Name: Extra_TruthWordNum
Functions.Original: static inline int   Extra_TruthWordNum( int nVars )  { return nVars <= 5 ? 1 : (1 << (nVars - 5)); }

Functions.Name: Extra_TruthSetBit
Functions.Original: static inline void  Extra_TruthSetBit( unsigned * p, int Bit )   { p[Bit>>5] |= (unsigned)(1<<(Bit & 31));               }
